subject.title: Anthropic replay fails with "Invalid signature in thinking block" for thinking-enabled sessions after tool loops (no compaction)

question: Should maintainers accept #99383 as the focused fix for this issue's non-Fable completed-turn Anthropic replay failure while leaving Fable 5 and recovery residuals to #94228/#92201, or require a broader fix before closing #99382?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible on main and the linked PR changes provider replay semantics; the newest Fable 5 repro appears outside the PR's preserved-Fable contract.

options.title: Accept focused PR path
options.body: Review and land #99383 for the native non-Fable no-compaction replay bug, then close this issue only with merge and validation proof while keeping broader residual work separate.

options.title: Require broader replay recovery
options.body: Hold #99383 or request expansion if maintainers want Fable 5 stale-signature recovery covered before this issue can close.

options.title: Route solely to older canonical issue
options.body: Close #99382 only if maintainers decide #94228 should be the sole canonical tracker despite #99383's direct closing link.

recommendation.title: Accept focused PR path
recommendation.body: Review and land #99383 for the native non-Fable no-compaction replay bug, then close this issue only with merge and validation proof while keeping broader residual work separate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal for the Anthropic replay-contract boundary and was also identified by prior review context as the replay-policy decision owner.
